feeds.title: Caitlin Houston Blog
feeds.description: A popular Connecticut based life and style blog featuring Caitlin's insights on motherhood, style, mental health, and more. Caitlin Houston is a Connecticut native, living in and exploring all that New England has to offer with her husband, Brandon, and daughters, Annabelle and Ailey.

feeds.title: Happily Eva After
feeds.description: My name is Eva Amurri, and I am a Mom, Actress, Entrepreneur, and Blogger! I launched HappilyEvaAfter.com in 2015 as a way to share my own multifaceted interests that range from Style, Decor, Food, and Crafting...to my role as a new Mama!

feeds.title: Not Your Average Mom Blog
feeds.description: Articles covering exercise, food, funny stuff, mental health, parenting, and self-care. Susie Johnson is Empowerment Expert, teaches you how to develop manageable and sustainable systems you can apply to all areas of your life.

feeds.title: Lemon Stripes
feeds.description: Lemon Stripes is a one stop shop for readers who want to live a happy, healthy and fashionable life. Julia Dzafic is the author behind Lemon Stripes and started the blog in 2010.

feeds.title: Connecticut in Style
feeds.description: I'm Sarah O'Brien, the Founder & Creative Director of the lifestyle blog, Connecticut in Style. This blog was born out of my desire to create and share beautiful things. I launched this blog in 2015 to highlight the best of what I find in Connecticut when exploring Fairfield County and beyond.

feeds.title: Red White & Denim
feeds.description: I'm Jen, the voice behind Red White & Denim. I was born and raised in Connecticut and can't imagine living anywhere but New England. My goal is to educate, help and inspire my readers through sharing my personal style and everyday experiences. So whether you are seeking advice, inspiration, recommendations or just a daily dose of New England living this is the right blog to check in.

feeds.title: Here Wee Read
feeds.description: Diversity & Inclusion Expert, Charnaie Gordon helps you find quality diverse & inclusive books for kids and kid-friendly educational products. She is dedicated to shaping our family culture around books. Here Wee Read is a blog resource dedicated to connecting people with diverse, and inclusive books.

feeds.title: Out and About Mom
feeds.description: Out and About Mom is a blog providing Connecticut parents with fun and creative ideas for family-friendly outings. Founded by Shawna and Mandy.

feeds.title: Kaitlin Madden Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my site, where I share updates to my homes in Connecticut and Vermont, plus the home decor and DIY expertise I've gained from spending more than 10 years as a writer and editor for interiors publications and brands.

feeds.title: Lauren McBride Blog
feeds.description: A Connecticut Based Life and Style Blog. Featuring style, beauty, home decor, and motherhood. Lauren McBride is the author and hopes to encourage and inspire other women in the vicinity.

feeds.title: Pure Joy Home
feeds.description: Lifestyle blogger Liz Joy shares her thoughts on fashion, motherhood, and living in general. Pure Joy Home was started back in 2015 to help new moms through various struggles.

feeds.title: The Wellthy Mom Blog
feeds.description: Covers motherhood, parenting, entrepreneurship, faith, family lifestyle, travel, healthy recipes, and more. Nathalie O'Donald is the author behind The WELLthy Mom Blog.

feeds.title: This Connecticut Mom
feeds.description: Helping parents make the most out of this Connecticut life. This Connecticut Mom is the place where CT moms can learn about events, news, reviews discounts, and other mommy stuff around the Nutmeg State.

feeds.title: Vineyard Loveknots
feeds.description: My name is Lindsay and I'm the author of Vineyard Loveknots, a New England and Fairfield County lifestyle blog. Join me as I shop, travel, dine and have fun with my friends and family.

feeds.title: Stamford Moms
feeds.description: Blog posts about community and parenting topics. Stamford Moms is a one stop shop offering up to date information and resources to Stamford families.

feeds.title: Fairfield Moms
feeds.description: We are here to be your go-to resource for everything in and around Fairfield, Connecticut! If you are looking for local activities for your kids, the best places for date nights, a new healthcare provider, delicious recipes, great blog posts or you simply want to stay in the know..FairfieldMoms is your one-stop-shop!

feeds.title: That Practical Mom
feeds.description: Find posts on life hacks, budgeting, simple DIYs, and motherhood. I'm Kallie Branciforte, the creator behind But First, Coffee. I'm a blogger, YouTuber, mom, wife, and usually in need of another cup of coffee.

feeds.title: Lynzy & Co.
feeds.description: A Connecticut based life & style blog for modern motherhood. Lynzy & Co. focuses on style, home decor, and everything baby & kids related.Lynzy is the editor behind Lynzy & Co and created this blog in 2011 to help other moms in the hardships.
